description: Read topics, comments, and replies in one recent-activity feed without choosing a target first. Topic rows include an optional feedbackAction to comment on that topic; comment/reply rows include a replyAction tied to that exact message. This is read-only: it never searches the KG, writes a post, or calls an LLM.

category.description: Optional community board, not the related entity or page.

offset.description: Use nextOffset while hasMore is true.

popular.description: Sort by discussion activity instead of latest first.

search.description: Optional words to find in topic titles, comments, or target names.

name: list_community_feed
title: Browse the public community feed
